Against Stanford in 2026, Nate Sheppard scored three touchdowns—two rushing and one receiving—and gained 154 rushing yards.
In the 2026 game against Miami, Nate Sheppard piled up 240 yards in three ways: 131 rushing, 93 receiving, and 16 passing. He also scored twice on the ground and caught a conversion pass.

# Nate Sheppard scores 3 TDs, Duke rallies to beat Illinois 31-27 for its sixth straight win

By AP

CHAMPAIGN, Ill. -- — [Nate Sheppard](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5164332/nate-sheppard) ran for 147 yards and a touchdown and caught two touchdown passes to lead Duke to a come-from-behind 31-27 victory Saturday over Illinois.

The victory was the sixth straight for the defending ACC champion Blue Devils in a streak that dates back to November 22, 2025, when they beat North Carolina 32-25.

Duke (2-0) fell behind 24-14 in the second quarter and was down 24-21 at halftime. The Blue Devils never trailed again after taking a 28-24 lead in the third quarter.

## Stanford Cardinal vs. Duke Blue Devils: Full Highlights

* * *

By AP

Updated: Sep 20, 2026, 12:28 am

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

DURHAM, N.C. -- — [Nate Sheppard](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5164332/nate-sheppard) scored on two runs and a reception, gained 154 yards on the ground and undefeated Duke beat Stanford 35-7 on Saturday.

Duke (3-0, 1-0 Atlantic Coast Conference), the defending conference champion, has won five consecutive ACC openers for the first time in program history.

Sheppard carried 23 times and scored on a 2-yard play on his lone catch.

“You have to let Nate Sheppard have his fingerprints on the game,” Duke coach Manny Diaz said.

[Nate Sheppard](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5164332/nate-sheppard) accounted for 240 yards — 131 rushing, 93 receiving and 16 passing — plus rushed for two scores and caught a conversion pass for Duke (7-3, 5-3). Sheppard had a pair of 47-yard runs in the game, along with 12 catches.

“What an advertisement for one of the best players in the United States," Duke coach Manny Diaz said of Sheppard, the first player to run for that many yards against Miami since September 2024.
